## Design roles

Each part does a job for the person. These are the jobs, as questions the part answers.

<div class="odv-am-rolelist"><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Containment</b> What holds this?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Layering</b> What sits on top?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Hierarchy</b> What do you read first?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Readability</b> Can you read it?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Emphasis</b> Where does the eye go?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Meaning</b> What state is it in?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Affordance</b> Can you act on it?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Feedback</b> Did it respond?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Focus</b> Where is the keyboard?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Grouping</b> What belongs together?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Reach</b> Can you hit it?</span></div>

## How the decisions reach each part

Each part follows a chain: an answer about the product, the rule it set, the token that carries it, and the value you see. The numbers match the drawing.

<section class="odv-am-card" id="part-1"><div class="odv-am-img wide"><span class="odv-am-assetbox odv-am-pending">Drawn in Figma by the Open DS anatomy plugin; the image is not exported yet.</span></div><div class="odv-am-body"><header><i class="odv-am-n">1</i><b>Label</b><span class="odv-am-role" title="Can you read it?">Readability</span><span class="odv-am-role" title="What do you read first?">Hierarchy</span></header><ul class="odv-am-tree"><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Answer</b><div class="odv-am-main">Typography · Which text roles does it need? → Core and editorial display</div><div class="odv-am-why">A lead and a display role open articles.</div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Rule</b><div class="odv-am-main">For field label or column header, use type.label. Don't use type.caption.</div><div class="odv-am-why">Caption is too faint for a label people must read.</div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Token</b><div class="odv-am-chain"><code>type.label.font-size</code><span>→</span><code>label.font-size</code><span class="odv-am-val">1rem</span><span class="odv-byscheme" title="Its value changes by scheme. The part is the same in every scheme."><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="11" height="11" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m11 10 3 3"/><path d="M6.5 21A3.5 3.5 0 1 0 3 17.5a2.62 2.62 0 0 1-.708 1.792A1 1 0 0 0 3 21z"/><path d="M9.969 17.031 21.378 5.624a1 1 0 0 0-3.002-3.002L6.967 14.031"/></svg>By scheme</span></div><div class="odv-am-lines"><div><b>Pick</b> font.weight.600</div></div></li></ul></div></section>

<section class="odv-am-card" id="part-2"><div class="odv-am-img wide"><span class="odv-am-assetbox odv-am-pending">Drawn in Figma by the Open DS anatomy plugin; the image is not exported yet.</span></div><div class="odv-am-body"><header><i class="odv-am-n">2</i><b>Description</b><span class="odv-am-role" title="Can you read it?">Readability</span><span class="odv-am-role" title="What do you read first?">Hierarchy</span></header><ul class="odv-am-tree"><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Answer</b><div class="odv-am-main">Typography · Which text roles does it need? → Core and editorial display</div><div class="odv-am-why">A lead and a display role open articles.</div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Answer</b><div class="odv-am-main">Color · Which color roles does it need? → Surface, text, action and status</div><div class="odv-am-why">Reading needs few color roles.</div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Answer</b><div class="odv-am-main">Spacing · How dense is the layout? → Spacious</div><div class="odv-am-why">Room around the text helps reading.</div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Rule</b><div class="odv-am-main">For paragraph or help text, use type.body, at most 65 characters a line. The part is the same in every scheme."><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="11" height="11" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m11 10 3 3"/><path d="M6.5 21A3.5 3.5 0 1 0 3 17.5a2.62 2.62 0 0 1-.708 1.792A1 1 0 0 0 3 21z"/><path d="M9.969 17.031 21.378 5.624a1 1 0 0 0-3.002-3.002L6.967 14.031"/></svg>By scheme</span></div><div class="odv-am-why">The quietest text.</div><div class="odv-am-lines"><div><b>Pick</b> neutral.600: the quietest text that still reads, 6.9:1 on surface.default, above the 4.5:1 floor.</div><div><b>Dark</b> neutral.400: the quietest text that still reads, 6.16:1 on surface.default, above the 4.5:1 floor.</div></div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Token</b><div class="odv-am-chain"><code>component-spacing-map.x1</code><span>→</span><code>description.margin-top</code><span class="odv-am-val">0.25rem</span></div><div class="odv-am-lines"><div><b>Pick</b> space.4</div></div></li></ul></div></section>

<section class="odv-am-card" id="part-3"><div class="odv-am-img wide"><span class="odv-am-assetbox odv-am-pending">Drawn in Figma by the Open DS anatomy plugin; the image is not exported yet.</span></div><div class="odv-am-body"><header><i class="odv-am-n">3</i><b>Error message</b><span class="odv-am-role" title="What state is it in?">Meaning</span><span class="odv-am-role" title="Did it respond?">Feedback</span></header><ul class="odv-am-tree"><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Answer</b><div class="odv-am-main">Color · Which color roles does it need? → Surface, text, action and status</div><div class="odv-am-why">Reading needs few color roles.</div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Answer</b><div class="odv-am-main">Accessibility · Which states get their own visible value? → Those and pressed</div><div class="odv-am-why">Pressed gets its own value for touch.</div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Rule</b><div class="odv-am-main">For an error message, use color.status.danger and a plain sentence. Take the blame, offer the way forward.. Don't use blaming the reader.</div><div class="odv-am-why">A calm error keeps the reader's trust.</div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Token</b><div class="odv-am-chain"><code>color.status.danger</code><span>→</span><code>error.label</code><span class="odv-am-val">#C42B2B · dark #F28B8B</span><span class="odv-byscheme" title="Its value changes by scheme. The top of the urgency order. Overuse wears it out.</div><div class="odv-am-lines"><div><b>Pick</b> red.light.600: danger reads as text and icons, 5.63:1 on surface.default, above the 4.5:1 floor.</div><div><b>Dark</b> red.dark.600: danger reads as text and icons, 7.21:1 on surface.default, above the 4.5:1 floor.</div><div><b>Shares the step with</b> action.danger. Changing this pick moves only what reads color.status.danger.</div></div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Token</b><div class="odv-am-chain"><code>type.body.font-weight</code><span>→</span><code>error.font-weight</code><span class="odv-am-val">400</span></div><div class="odv-am-lines"><div><b>Pick</b> font.weight.400</div></div></li></ul></div></section>

Sharp corners feel technical next to long text.</div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Rule</b><div class="odv-am-main">For the smallest clickable thing, use size.control.default (touch). Don't use a compact control.</div><div class="odv-am-why">Many readers are on phones.</div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Token</b><div class="odv-am-chain"><code>radius.control</code><span>→</span><code>label.radius</code><span class="odv-am-val">0.5rem</span><span class="odv-byscheme" title="Its value changes by scheme. The part is the same in every scheme."><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="11" height="11" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m11 10 3 3"/><path d="M6.5 21A3.5 3.5 0 1 0 3 17.5a2.62 2.62 0 0 1-.708 1.792A1 1 0 0 0 3 21z"/><path d="M9.969 17.031 21.378 5.624a1 1 0 0 0-3.002-3.002L6.967 14.031"/></svg>By scheme</span></div><div class="odv-am-lines"><div><b>Pick</b> radius.8: Rounded corners feel friendly.</div></div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Token</b><div class="odv-am-chain"><code>component-spacing-map.x4</code><span>→</span><code>label.padding</code><span class="odv-am-val">1.5rem</span><span class="odv-byscheme" title="Its value changes by scheme. The part is the same in every scheme."><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="11" height="11" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m11 10 3 3"/><path d="M6.5 21A3.5 3.5 0 1 0 3 17.5a2.62 2.62 0 0 1-.708 1.792A1 1 0 0 0 3 21z"/><path d="M9.969 17.031 21.378 5.624a1 1 0 0 0-3.002-3.002L6.967 14.031"/></svg>By scheme</span></div><div class="odv-am-lines"><div><b>Pick</b> space.24</div></div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Token</b><div class="odv-am-chain"><code>border-width.default</code><span>→</span><code>label.border-width</code><span class="odv-am-val">1px</span><span class="odv-byscheme" title="Its value changes by scheme. The part is the same in every scheme."><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="11" height="11" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m11 10 3 3"/><path d="M6.5 21A3.5 3.5 0 1 0 3 17.5a2.62 2.62 0 0 1-.708 1.792A1 1 0 0 0 3 21z"/><path d="M9.969 17.031 21.378 5.624a1 1 0 0 0-3.002-3.002L6.967 14.031"/></svg>By scheme</span></div><div class="odv-am-lines"><div><b>Pick</b> border-width.1</div></div></li></ul></div></section>

<section class="odv-am-card" id="part-6"><div class="odv-am-img wide"><span class="odv-am-assetbox odv-am-pending">Drawn in Figma by the Open DS anatomy plugin; the image is not exported yet.</span></div><div class="odv-am-body"><header><i class="odv-am-n">6</i><b>Checked choice card</b><span class="odv-am-role" title="What state is it in?">Meaning</span><span class="odv-am-role" title="Did it respond?">Feedback</span></header><ul class="odv-am-tree"><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Answer</b><div class="odv-am-main">Color · Which color roles does it need? → Surface, text, action and status</div><div class="odv-am-why">Reading needs few color roles.</div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Rule</b><div class="odv-am-main">For a selected row or item, use color.surface.selected. Don't use bold text only.</div><div class="odv-am-why">A tint shows the choice clearly on warm paper.</div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Token</b><div class="odv-am-chain"><code>color.border.selected</code><span>→</span><code>label.border.checked</code><span class="odv-am-val">#1E3A5F · dark #8FA6C4</span><span class="odv-byscheme" title="Its value changes by scheme. The part is the same in every scheme."><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="11" height="11" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m11 10 3 3"/><path d="M6.5 21A3.5 3.5 0 1 0 3 17.5a2.62 2.62 0 0 1-.708 1.792A1 1 0 0 0 3 21z"/><path d="M9.969 17.031 21.378 5.624a1 1 0 0 0-3.002-3.002L6.967 14.031"/></svg>By scheme</span></div><div class="odv-am-why">The edge that marks a selected item, beside its fill, so selection is never color alone.</div><div class="odv-am-lines"><div><b>Pick</b> navy.light.600: the edge beside a selected fill, so selection is never color alone, 11.5:1 on surface.default, above the 3:1 floor.</div><div><b>Dark</b> navy.dark.600: the edge beside a selected fill, so selection is never color alone, 6.86:1 on surface.default, above the 3:1 floor.</div><div><b>Shares the step with</b> border.focus, action.primary, category.1. Changing this pick moves only what reads color.border.selected.</div></div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Token</b><div class="odv-am-chain"><code>color.surface.selected</code><span>→</span><code>label.background.checked</code><span class="odv-am-val">#E0E9F5 · dark #202B3B</span><span class="odv-byscheme" title="Its value changes by scheme. The part is the same in every scheme."><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="11" height="11" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m11 10 3 3"/><path d="M6.5 21A3.5 3.5 0 1 0 3 17.5a2.62 2.62 0 0 1-.708 1.792A1 1 0 0 0 3 21z"/><path d="M9.969 17.031 21.378 5.624a1 1 0 0 0-3.002-3.002L6.967 14.031"/></svg>By scheme</span></div><div class="odv-am-why">The fill of a selected or current item, or a toggle that is on.</div><div class="odv-am-lines"><div><b>Pick</b> navy.light.100: a tint of the brand, 1.22:1 from content, always beside its edge (border.selected), so selection is never color alone.</div><div><b>Dark</b> navy.dark.100: a tint of the brand, 1.2:1 from content, always beside its edge (border.selected), so selection is never color alone.</div><div><b>Shares the step with</b> category.1.subtle. Changing this pick moves only what reads color.surface.selected.</div></div></li></ul></div></section>

<section class="odv-am-card" id="part-7"><div class="odv-am-img wide"><span class="odv-am-assetbox odv-am-pending">Drawn in Figma by the Open DS anatomy plugin; the image is not exported yet.</span></div><div class="odv-am-body"><header><i class="odv-am-n">7</i><b>Separator</b><span class="odv-am-role" title="What belongs together?">Grouping</span></header><ul class="odv-am-tree"><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Answer</b><div class="odv-am-main">Spacing · How dense is the layout? → Spacious</div><div class="odv-am-why">Room around the text helps reading.</div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Rule</b><div class="odv-am-main">For between page sections, use space.gap.section, no line. Don't use a divider line.</div><div class="odv-am-why">Space alone separates sections; lines add noise.</div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Token</b><div class="odv-am-chain"><code>component-spacing-map.x2</code><span>→</span><code>separator.margin-y</code><span class="odv-am-val">0.5rem</span></div><div class="odv-am-lines"><div><b>Pick</b> space.8</div></div></li></ul></div></section>

## For agents

Agents get this same anatomy: every part, its roles, whether it is required, the tokens it reads and the decisions behind them.

- **From an AI agent:** call the `get_anatomy` tool on the Open DS MCP server, with this scheme and `field`.
- **From a terminal:** `npx open-ds anatomy content-first field`
